allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Indowind Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Rights Issue Committee meeting held on December 12, 2025.

allot.subject: Press Release
allot.text: Indowind Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated December 11, 2025, titled "RIGHTS ISSUE OF 3,22,00,434 EQUITY SHARES OF INDOWIND ENERGY LIMITED ".

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Indowind Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'LETTER OF OFFER- RIGHTS ISSUE'.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Indowind Energy Limited has informed the Exchange that Rights Issue Committee at its meeting held on November 13, 2025, has approved letter of offer to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 1 : 4, i.e 1 Equity Shares for every 4 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is 15.35 per share.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Indowind Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about In Principal Approval of DLOF of Rights Issue

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Indowind Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'DRAFT LEETER OF OFFER - RIGHTS ISSUE'.

allot.subject: Committee Meeting Updates
allot.text: Indowind Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Rights Issue Committee Meeting held on July 15, 2025.
